_note: PLACEHOLDER — original, hand-written questions generic to this firm's public programmes, for pipeline testing. Loaded as status=generated (student-invisible) until a human approves them in /admin/firms. recency_year is null everywhere: no provenance is claimed.

questions.question: Why Goldman Sachs, and not one of our competitors?
questions.guidance_md:
- Something specific about Goldman Sachs: a business it is known for, a deal, its strategy — its Asset & Wealth Management growth push and the One Goldman Sachs client approach
- A person you have spoken to and what they told you about the culture
- How that matches the way you like to work
- Never answer with reputation alone — every applicant says 'prestige'

questions.question: Which of our businesses would you want to join and why Global Banking & Markets?
questions.guidance_md:
- Show you know what Global Banking & Markets does at Goldman Sachs specifically
- Tie it to a skill or experience of yours
- Mention one recent piece of work by that business you have read about

questions.question: 'Partnership' is one of the things we say we care about. When have you shown it?
questions.guidance_md:
- Give one concrete story that fits the value without stretching
- Say what you did, not what the group did
- Explain why that value matters in client work at a bank

questions.question: What do you think the biggest strategic question facing Goldman Sachs is right now?
questions.guidance_md:
- Show you know the firm's current direction: its Asset & Wealth Management growth push and the One Goldman Sachs client approach
- Argue one question with a mechanism, not a list of headlines
- Say what you would watch to know whether it is going well

questions.question: How does Goldman Sachs make money, and which parts of the bank are doing well?
questions.guidance_md:
- Split revenue into fees (advisory, underwriting), trading, net interest and asset management fees
- Know the rough shape of the last results — direction, not decimals
- Name one division that has been strong and one under pressure

questions.question: Tell me about a time you had to deliver a piece of work to a deadline you thought was unrealistic.
questions.guidance_md:
- Set the scene in one sentence: the task, the deadline, why it was tight
- Say what you prioritised and what you consciously dropped
- Show how you communicated early with whoever set the deadline
- Give the outcome and one thing you would do differently

questions.question: Describe a situation where you disagreed with someone senior to you. What did you do?
questions.guidance_md:
- Pick an example where you were respectful but did not just cave
- Explain how you made the case with evidence rather than opinion
- Show you accepted the final decision and made it work
- Reflect on what the disagreement taught you about influencing

questions.question: Give an example of a time you worked in a team that was not functioning well.
questions.guidance_md:
- Diagnose why it was not working without blaming individuals
- Describe the specific step you took to change the dynamic
- Show the result in terms the team cared about
- Keep it short: interviewers want the action, not the drama

questions.question: Tell me about a mistake you made and how you handled it.
questions.guidance_md:
- Choose a real mistake with real consequences, not a humble-brag
- Own it plainly in the first sentence
- Explain how you fixed it and who you told
- End with the habit you changed afterwards

questions.question: When have you had to learn something technical very quickly?
questions.guidance_md:
- Name the skill and why it mattered at the time
- Describe your method: sources, practice, feedback
- Quantify how fast and how well you got there
- Link it to how you would learn the job in the first month

questions.question: Walk me through your CV in two minutes.
questions.guidance_md:
- Chronological but selective: three or four beats, not every line
- Each beat ends with what it taught you or why it led to the next
- Finish on why this role is the logical next step
- Practise it out loud to hit two minutes

questions.question: What do you do outside of your studies, and why?
questions.guidance_md:
- One or two interests with genuine depth beat a long list
- Show commitment over time and something you have achieved in it
- Make one link to a quality the job needs without forcing it

questions.question: What would your friends say is your biggest weakness?
questions.guidance_md:
- A real weakness that is not fatal for the job
- Evidence you have noticed it and a concrete thing you do about it
- Do not offer a strength dressed up as a weakness

questions.question: Where do you see yourself in five years?
questions.guidance_md:
- Show ambition inside the firm, not a plan to leave
- Talk about the skills and responsibility you want, not the title
- Acknowledge the plan will change and that you are open to that

questions.question: Tell me about a deal or market story you have followed recently. Why did it interest you?
questions.guidance_md:
- One story, told with the key numbers: size, price, premium or move
- Explain the rationale from both sides and what the market reaction said
- Say what you think happens next and why
- Connect it to the division you are applying to
